It sounds like this situation is causing you a lot of distress and confusion, and that's completely understandable. When you can't make sense of what someone is doing, it can feel really unsettling and even make you question your own perception.

I can't determine whether he's talking to himself or someone else, but what matters most right now is how this is affecting you. If you're feeling manipulated or like you're being made to doubt your own reality, that's a serious concern worth exploring with a trusted professional, such as a counselor or therapist, who can help you sort through what you're experiencing. You might also consider talking openly with him about how his behavior is impacting you, if you feel safe doing so. Your feelings are valid, and you deserve clarity and support.
